create_autotrain_client: create an AutoTrain Client instance with a host url, auth token, and username
create_training_project: create a new AutoTrain training project with a task, base model, backend, and dataset
get_training_logs: get the training logs for a given AutoTrain job id
stop_training_job: stop the training for a given AutoTrain job id
review_client_class: review the AutoTrain Client class methods for creating projects, retrieving logs, and stopping training
